tbesh_html: slaughtered meat, a slaughter, flesh, meat, thing slaughtered

strongs_1890.strongs_def: {properly, something slaughtered; hence, a beast (or meat, as butchered); abstractly butchery (or concretely, a place of slaughter)}
strongs_1890.derivation: feminine of H2874 (טֶבַח) and meaning the same
